context: Family dinner at a sushi restaurant with parents and child
purpose: Teach: 寿司/麺/花火/親切/暗い/天井/払う/終わら

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、この寿司屋、天井がすごく高いね！
lines.en: Wow, this sushi restaurant has such a high ceiling!
lines.style: Excited teenage observation, casual and bright tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当ね。でも少し暗いお店だから、メニューがよく見えないかも。
lines.en: Really. But it's a slightly dark restaurant, so the menu might be hard to see.
lines.style: Warm motherly comment, gentle and observant.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 店員さんがとても親切だから、聞けば大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: The staff is very kind, so it'll be fine if we just ask.
lines.style: Reassuring fatherly tone, calm and friendly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえお父さん、私やっぱり寿司より麺類が食べたいなあ。
lines.en: Hey Dad, actually I want noodles more than sushi.
lines.style: Whining teenage request, playful and slightly spoiled.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 桜、せっかく来たんだから今日はお寿司にしましょう。
lines.en: Sakura, we came all the way here, so let's have sushi today.
lines.style: Gentle motherly persuasion, soft but firm.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 食べ終わらないうちに、隣の公園で花火大会が始まるらしいぞ。
lines.en: Apparently, the fireworks festival next door starts before we even finish eating.
lines.style: Excited fatherly news-sharing, enthusiastic and informative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当！？じゃあ急いで食べて花火見に行こう！
lines.en: Really? Then let's eat quickly and go see the fireworks!
lines.style: Eager teenage excitement, energetic and pushy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。お父さんがお会計を払うまで待ってね。
lines.en: Calm down. Wait until Dad pays the bill, okay?
lines.style: Patient motherly instruction, lightly amused tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: はいはい、ちゃんと払うから、ゆっくり最後まで食べなさい。
lines.en: Yes yes, I'll pay properly, so eat slowly until the end.
lines.style: Good-humored fatherly response, warm and indulgent.
